in_arabic.name: عَظنور
in_arabic.long_meaning: الاسم عَظنور يأتي من الجذر ع-ظ-ن، و يرمز إلى الأسماء الكبرى، و النعماء، و هو من الأسماء التي ذُكرت في القرآن الكريم، و لها أهمية كبيرة في الإسلام، و تستخدم في الأسماء الشخصية، و تحمل معنى العظمة، و الكبرياء، و النعمة، و الحمية، و الفضائل، و هي من الأسماء التي تعكس جوهر الإسلام، و قيمته العليا.

in_urdu.name: عَظنور
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام عظنور عظیم ناموں اور نعماں والی ہے، جس کا تعلق الجذر ع-ظ-ن سے ہے۔ اس نام کے ذریعے عظمت اور کبریائی کو ظاہر کیا جاتا ہے۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں مذکور ہے اور اسلامی روایات میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ یہ نام مسلمانوں کے لیے الگ اور ممتاز ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फ़रहान
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम फ़रहान बड़े नामों और नعمाओं वाला है, जिसका संबंध जذر ع-ظ-न से है। इस नाम के माध्यम से महानता और विशेषता को प्रकट किया जाता है। यह नाम कुरआन में उल्लिखित है और इस्लामी परंपराओं में महत्वपूर्ण है।

in_pashto.name: عَظنور
in_pashto.long_meaning: نام عظنور دېرې نوموځي اوګټل دی، چې په جذر ع-ظ-ن کې رولېږي. دې نوم له قرآن کریم سره تړاو لري، او په اسلامي روایتو کې یې لویه اهمیت لري.

in_english.meaning: One with great names and blessings
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aznour originates from the Arabic root 'a-z-z-n' and signifies one with great names and blessings. It is mentioned in the Quran and holds significant importance in Islamic tradition. This name is associated with the qualities of grandeur, nobility, and goodness, reflecting the essence of Islam and its high values.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aznour, of Berber origin, holds a rich cultural significance in Moroccan society. It is a name given to individuals born during the harvest season or to those who have brought prosperity and success to their families. The name is also often associated with the esteemed profession of farming and agriculture. In the Berber communities of Morocco, the name Aznour is hold in high regard, representing the essential role of farmers and the fertility of the land in their culture.
data.spiritual_significance: Aznour is a name deeply rooted in the spirituality of its bearers. The name implies a deep sense of hope and faith, as one who brings light to the darkness. In Islamic teachings, it represents the belief that even in the bleakest of situations, there is always a way to find light and guidance through the will of Allah. The name Aznour embodies the spirit of perseverance, courage, and determination, encouraging its bearers to illuminate the way for others and instill a sense of hope amidst adversity.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Light of the night" symbolizes One who brings light to the darkness. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Aznour serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of light of the night.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Aznour was a Berber saint and martyr who lived during the Roman Empire. The name Aznour carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Aznour is considered a patron saint of the Berber people and is venerated in Algeria and Tunisia.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Aznour remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Zainab Aznour in Istanbul, Turkey attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Aznour, which means "Light of the night". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
